zh-CN.title: QQ 历史评论关系更清晰
items: 回复层主的历史评论会直接归入对应楼层，不再重复显示 @昵称
对楼内其他人的提及现在可以点击，并会在对方绑定 QQ 后自动关联新账号
尚未认领的 QQ 用户会显示其 QQ 头像

en.title: Clearer historical QQ comment threads
items: Replies to a thread owner now sit directly in that thread without repeating an @name prefix
Mentions of other participants are now interactive and follow them when they claim their QQ identity
Unclaimed QQ users now display their QQ avatar
